about: Agent Link's own tools kept as data, run by agentlink/runners.py: a wrapper of one FreeCAD command (make, apply, command, read) or a list of steps. Descriptions, schemas and refusals are the tools' own, word for word.

pd_clone.description: A new PartDesign body on another object's shape (PartDesign Clone): from (a body, a Part solid, anything with a shape), at [x,y,z] and axis, angle to place it, name. Its first feature (BaseFeature) follows the original; pd_ features go on top. Reply: body, from, volume.

fields.note: A body built on the other's shape: its BaseFeature follows the original; add pd_ features on top (sketch_new on its planes or faces).

bim_level.description: A level (Building Storey) holding objects (labels), its floor at elevation mm; height: floor to floor. A container, not a lift: BIM components keep their own Z (build an upper storey on points with z); plain shapes put in it move up by the elevation. Then bim_building { levels }.

bim_pipe.description: A pipe swept along points [[x, y, z] …] mm: diameter (50), wall (thickness). Corners are sharp: bim_pipe_connector joins separate pipes with a bend. Answers diameter, length, box.

rules.message: This FreeCAD's BIM has no pipe.

bim_equipment.description: An object made BIM equipment (furniture, fixtures): object (a shape), ifc (FreeCAD's spaced type name: Furniture, Sanitary Terminal; a wrong one is refused with near names), model, url, watts.

rules.message: This FreeCAD's BIM has no equipment.

bim_list.description: The BIM objects: each one's label, ifc type, holds (what a level, building or site contains), in (the wall a window or door is set into). Changes nothing.

bim_remove_shape.description: Remove Shape from BIM: structures and walls whose shape is a plain box are rebuilt from their sizes; the new object carries the old one's internal name as its label. Anything else is left as it was.

fields.note: Box-shaped structures and walls among them were rebuilt from their length, width and height and now carry their old internal name as label (object_list shows them); the rest were left as they were.

bim_structural_system.description: One structure copied to every crossing of two axis sets (bim_grid's "Grid X", "Grid Y"), or along one. Its own position is added to each crossing: make it at [0, 0, 0]. structures: one per call. Answers system, copies (0: the axes do not cross).

rules.message: structures: one structure per call (FreeCAD makes a separate system for each); call again for the next.
axes: one or two axis objects (bim_grid makes them: "Grid X", "Grid Y").

bim_pipe_connector.description: A connector where the ends of two pipes meet (an elbow) or three (a tee): pipes (labels), radius of the bend mm (the pipe's diameter when left out). An error state on it means the ends do not meet.

rules.message: pipes: two pipes (an elbow) or three (a tee) whose ends meet at one point; bim_pipe makes them.

meshobj_offset.description: Move a mesh's surface along its point normals by distance mm (negative: inward); triangles the move turns over are collapsed, so a distance beyond the tightest inside radius damages the mesh: meshobj_info after. In place; copy: true makes a new mesh. Reply: offset, the mesh's reading.

mesh.description: The mesh's label; may be left out when there is one.

rules.message: distance: mm along the normals (negative: inward).

draft_to_sketch.description: Draft shapes (or other flat shapes with edges) made into one new sketch on their plane: objects (all flat, in one plane); constrain: true (default) adds coincident, horizontal and vertical constraints where they hold, no dimensions; delete: true removes the originals. Reply: object, geometry, constraints (counts), length, box; sketch_state reads its degrees of freedom.

rules.message: Draft could not make a sketch of those: every object needs a shape, flat, and all in one plane (FreeCAD's report view names which failed). draft_modify op move or part_transform lays them in one plane first.

bim_wall.description: A wall along points [[x, y(, z)] …] mm (closed: true joins the last to the first) or a base sketch/wire: width (200), height (3000). align center | left (the line is the wall's left face going from the first point, so the wall lies to its right) | right. Answers length, box, min, volume_m3, base (the line bim_opening measures along).

rules.message: align: center (the line runs down the middle), left (the line is the wall's left face going from the first point on: the wall lies to the right) or right (the wall lies to the left).
points [[x, y] …] (the wall's line, mm) or base (a sketch or wire's label): one of them.
base: {base.Label} has no edges to run a wall along; give a sketch or wire, or points [[x, y] …].

bim_section.description: A section plane through objects (every BIM object not in a level when left out): at ([0, 0, 1200]), normal ([0, 0, 1]: a plan cut). It draws nothing itself: td_bim puts it on a page; export { section: z } writes a plan cut as DXF/SVG.

rules.message: This FreeCAD's BIM has no section plane.
normal: a direction, not [0, 0, 0] ([0, 0, 1] for a plan cut, [0, 1, 0] for a section looking along Y).
Nothing to cut: no BIM objects here; give objects, or make some first (bim_wall …).

fields.note: A section plane for TechDraw (td_bim of it) and the FreeCAD window; export { section: z } writes a plan cut as DXF/SVG headless.

bim_reference.description: An external reference: another file's objects shown here and updated with it, not copied. path: the full path of an .FCStd (or .ifc, .dxf); part: one of its parts. Answers reference, file, volume, box.

rules.message: path {path!r}: no such file. Give the full path of an .FCStd (or .ifc, .dxf) to reference.

fields.note: Shown from the other file and kept up to date with it; not copied in.

Whatever preset says, it is a plain frame round a pane or a door panel. Answers wallCut_m3 (0 with a warning: nothing was cut), opening (the cutting box), box, min.
